description: January 6 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 2, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 6 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the second decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 6 birthday
paragraphs: Halfway through the Venus decan of Capricorn, around fifteen degrees in, January 6 carries the caretaking number 6. Traditional readings link 6 with home, responsibility and service. Here that concern for others is expressed through reliability: the person who remembers the appointment, fixes the leaking tap and quietly takes on the duty nobody else volunteered for.

By noon UTC on January 6, the Sun has normally reached roughly 15° of Capricorn. That places the date in the Capricorn decan that astrologers give to Venus, the second of three. In the middle of Capricorn, from 10 to 19 degrees, Venus acts as sub-ruler, borrowed from Taurus. Birthdays from about January 1 to January 10 tend to soften the Goat's seriousness with an appreciation of comfort, quality and beauty. These Capricorns are often pictured as both ambitious and sensual: they want to build something, and they want it well made and pleasant to live with. Loyalty in relationships is usually strong. Venus can make material security feel especially important. Remembering that enjoyment is part of success, not a reward postponed for later, often brings this decan balance.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 6 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 6th produces a birthday number of 6, unreduced. As the secondary number in a chart, the day of birth hints at how someone naturally contributes to the people around them. The 6 is the number of the household in Pythagorean tradition: care, responsibility, beauty in the home and fairness within the family. Those born on the 6th are often the friend who remembers birthdays and notices when someone is struggling. Their usual lesson is that looking after others works best when they include themselves in the circle of care too.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 6 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 6 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 6 is the 6th day of the year. In most years Aquarius season is under way by January 21, 15 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 6 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year. January 6 is also the birthday of Kahlil Gibran (1883), Rowan Atkinson (1955) and Kim Dae-jung (1924).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 6?
faq.answer: January 6 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 6?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 6 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 6th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 6?
faq.answer: In the Chinese zodiac a January 6 birth comes before the new year has turned, so the animal is the one that began the previous winter.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 6?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 6 birthday are Kahlil Gibran (1883), Rowan Atkinson (1955) and Kim Dae-jung (1924). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
